name: Rate Limit API Calls
description: Rate limits external API calls by tracking call frequency and blocking if threshold is exceeded within a time window
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Rate limit external API calls
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
RATE_FILE="/tmp/claude-api-rate-limit"
MAX_CALLS=${CLAUDE_API_RATE_LIMIT:-30}
WINDOW=60
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(curl|wget|http|fetch)\s'; then
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  # Clean old entries
  if [[ -f "$RATE_FILE" ]]; then
    CUTOFF=$((NOW - WINDOW))
    awk -v cutoff="$CUTOFF" '$1 > cutoff' "$RATE_FILE" > "${RATE_FILE}.tmp"
    mv "${RATE_FILE}.tmp" "$RATE_FILE"
    COUNT=$(wc -l < "$RATE_FILE")
    if [[ $COUNT -ge $MAX_CALLS ]]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: API rate limit exceeded ($MAX_CALLS calls per ${WINDOW}s). Wait before making more requests."
      exit 2
    fi
  fi
  echo "$NOW" >> "$RATE_FILE"
fi
exit 0
